project.name: KHKD - Muoi Van
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — muoi van Aedes va sot xuat huyet
project.story: Aedes aegypti, the tiger mosquito (muoi van), causes more human disease than any other animal — dengue, Zika, chikungunya. Only female mosquitoes bite because they need blood protein for eggs. They find humans through exhaled CO2, body heat, and chemical signatures in sweat. Their proboscis is not one needle but six separate stylets that cut, probe for a blood vessel, and inject saliva. They breed in tiny pools of standing water. Vietnamese cities see dengue outbreaks every monsoon season.
